pubs.name: The Exchange Bar & Restaurant
pubs.shows: Premier League, La Liga, Champions League, international rugby and other major sport (per the venue's homepage)
pubs.screens: The homepage says 8 large screens; a later answer on the same page says 7 large-screen TVs
pubs.booking: Reserve a table on the site; groups over 8 by email hello@the-exchange.pl or phone

pubs.name: Nines Sports Bar
pubs.address: Warzelnia / Browary Warszawskie, Haberbuscha i Schielego 6, 00-844 Warsaw
pubs.shows: Sports broadcasts on four independent feeds. The page does not name the Premier League or Champions League
pubs.screens: 20 screens on level −1, around a central bar (per own site). The site says the bar was created by Robert Lewandowski

pubs.name: Legia Sports Bar & Rest
pubs.shows: Every Legia match and major events. The published schedule (checked Oct 2026) includes Premier League fixtures as well as Ekstraklasa
pubs.screens: Largest LED screen in Warsaw plus 11 × 55-inch TVs (per own site)
pubs.booking: sportsbar@legia.pl — the site says to book a table for a listed match
pubs.hours: Open daily from 12:00 until the end of the last broadcast

pubs.name: English Football Club (EFC) Kraków
pubs.address: Mikołajska 5, Kraków (the site prints both 31-027 and 33-332)
pubs.shows: League and championship games, 'especially the English Premier League' (per own site)

pubs.name: Winners Steakhouse / The Winners Pub
pubs.shows: Champions League, Premier League (the site spells it 'Premiere League'), La Liga, Serie A, Bundesliga, rugby, boxing, volleyball, basketball
pubs.screens: 10 × 4K UHD TVs and one 120-inch projection screen (per own site)
pubs.hours: Every day 12:00–24:00 (the page also lists Monday 12:00–24:00)

pubs.name: Alibi
pubs.shows: The schedule page lists Ekstraklasa, Champions League and Nations League. It says to call and check a specific match. Premier League is not named

pubs.name: Grass British Sports Pub
pubs.shows: English, Scottish and Irish football, and the Champions League (per own site)

pubs.name: Football Pub
pubs.shows: The city tourism page describes a football pub (opened 1995) with Widzew and ŁKS scarves side by side. It does not list which competitions are shown
pubs.source_note: Łódź official tourism portal (lodz.travel), not the pub's own site. A phone number on that page sits next to the tourism-office address, so it is not listed here.
